title: A PWM wave with a given duty
task: Make GP14 a PWM output of 1 kHz that is high for 25 % of each period (250 µs), keep it running for 20 ms, then set its level to 0 and return 0. Compute from CLK_SYS_HZ so that it works at every clk_sys. The tests measure the period and the high time on the pin, within 1 %.
